name: indianinprague
description: Build pipeline for guldaarbazaar.com. The site itself has no dependencies — every script under scripts/ imports only node: builtins, deliberately. This file exists for exactly one reason: to pin wrangler.
comment: Why wrangler is pinned to an exact version with a lockfile, rather than invoked as
`npx wrangler`: publish.sh runs unattended from launchd every morning WITH A CLOUDFLARE
DEPLOY TOKEN IN THE ENVIRONMENT. `npx wrangler` resolves the latest version from the
npm registry at run time, which means a freshly published wrangler — or a freshly
compromised one, or any of its 37 transitive dependencies — would execute here, with
that token, before anyone looked at it. An exact version plus package-lock.json means
the bytes that ran yesterday are the bytes that run today, and an upgrade is a decision
someone makes rather than something that happens overnight.
node_modules/ is never staged into dist/ — build-dist.mjs copies an explicit list.
